<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex06012025-05-1312-21-17" status="finalized"><lb n="20a1"/> zhes pa man chad degs gzhi'i bsam pa yin te | ched du bya ba sems can gyi don du smon par 'di thams cad don mthun pa'i phyir ro || 
               sbyor ba'i tshe ngag ni sngar bshad pa brgyad de | mchod pa dang | bstod pa dang | phyag brtsal ba dang | skyabs su 'gro ba dang | sdig pa bshags pa dang | rjes su yi rang pa dang | <lb n="20a2"/> bskul ba dang | gsol ba 'o zhes <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">nga</rs></note><note type="editorial">"nga" in dbu can</note> gsung yang | bsngo' ba med na sbyor ba ma tshang par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang | <quote source="db:3727" n="7a">lus dang de bzhin long spyod dang ||</quote> ces pa man chad ni bsam pa 'di ltar bskyed par bya' <note type="gloss">zhes</note> dngos gzhi'o bsam pa'i khyad par <note type="gloss">du</note> snang la | <quote source="db:3727" n="7a">mdun du nye bar gnas gyur cig</quote> zhes pa yan chad ni 'di ltar gyur cig ces yongs su bsngo ba nyid du snang pa'i phyir |</seg></TEI>
